meta.title: SC Trade — a price diary and trade routes for Star Citizen
meta.description: A small window over the game: write down terminal prices, see what a route earns and how long a trip takes. An unofficial fan project.
meta.data_description: What the SC Trade site keeps, what the feedback form sends and what the server sees. The app sends nothing to the site.

hero.title: SC Trade
hero.lead: A personal price diary and trade-route helper. A small window over the game.
hero.disclaimer: Unofficial fan project. Not affiliated with Cloud Imperium Games.
facts: Profit and time of a trip

features.label: Features
features.title: What it does
features.intro: You enter the prices you see on the terminals in the game. The app works out the rest, on your own computer.

items.title: A price diary
items.text: Write down the prices you see on the terminals. The app keeps them, marks how fresh they are and works out what a route earns.

items.title: Your prices come first
items.text: UEX reference prices fill in where you have none of your own yet. Until your own price has gone cold, it is the one the numbers use.

items.title: Records and a reference
items.text: All your prices in one list: correct or remove them, doubtful ones are marked. The commodity reference names the ten best places to buy or sell.

items.title: A trip in one line
items.text: Your first purchase starts the timer. Folded, the window is a mini line: the cargo, the expected profit and the mark buttons «Взлетел» (departed) and «Прилетел» (arrived).

items.title: Sell here or fly on
items.text: When you have a price of your own here that has not gone cold, the app compares selling here with other buyers: how much more they pay and how long the flight is.

items.title: Correcting a trade
items.text: Typed a wrong price or quantity? Correct the trade instead of writing the cargo off. The profit of the trip, the routes and what the session earned follow by themselves.

items.title: Storage at the station
items.text: Bought more than your hold takes? The rest is left at the storage of the station with its purchase price. The Storage tab tells where to haul it, Loaded starts the next trip, and the mini line reminds you of what lies there.

items.title: The best from where you are
items.text: The «Лучшее» (best) button shows the best options from your current location: where to haul, what it brings and how long it takes, sorted by profit or by ROI. The «Маршрут» (route) button picks goods for two places of your own choice.

items.title: My routes
items.text: Your trips add up to a ranking of routes by profit per trip, a history of trips and what a session earned.

items.title: Favourite routes
items.text: Star a route, and the window tells you with a sound when the stock at its purchase terminal is full, and leaves a mark in the mini line.

safety.label: Safety
safety.title: Beside the game, not inside it
safety.intro: SC Trade is an ordinary Windows window that stays on top of the others. Here is what it does and what it does not.

items.title: A window over the game
items.text: The game has to run in borderless window mode. The window is not drawn over exclusive fullscreen.

items.title: Never takes the keyboard by itself
items.text: The keyboard goes to the window only while you type into a text field — after your click on it — and after the input goes back to the window that had it (usually the game). Esc in a field gives it back at once.

items.title: No injection, no reading of the game's memory
items.text: The app does not read the game's memory and injects nothing into other processes; it opens no handle of another process. To tell whose window is active, it asks Windows which process the active window belongs to (and, with the cursor diagnostics switched on, the window under the cursor), and compares the process number only with its own: the other number is not kept anywhere and not written to the log.

items.title: Presses nothing for you
items.text: The app sends no key presses and no clicks. Keys are assigned in the settings; nothing is assigned by default. While at least one is assigned, Windows calls the app on every press of any key. For a key that is not assigned the app returns at once: it does not read the state of Ctrl, Alt and Shift and remembers nothing. It passes every press on: the game gets it as usual.

items.title: Online only for UEX data
items.text: Everything is worked out on your computer. The app goes online only for the UEX reference lists and reference prices (api.uexcorp.uk).

items.title: Your data stays on your disk
items.text: The settings, your prices and your trips live in one database in your Windows user folder; the five latest backups are kept next to it.

items.title: The code is open
items.text: The source code of the application and of this site is on GitHub under the MIT licence. What is said above can be checked against the code; the list of permissions of the application's window and the ban on loading anything from a foreign address are pinned by tests. More in SECURITY.md of the repository.

safety.unsigned_text: The file has no digital signature, so Windows may show a SmartScreen warning. Whether to run it is your call: compare the SHA-256 of the file you downloaded with the sum in the “Download” section.

download.title: The installer for Windows

The game in borderless window mode.
It installs for the current user; no administrator rights are needed.
The installer and the app are in English and Russian; the language is chosen at the first start.

smartscreen: The installer is not signed, so Windows may show a SmartScreen window.
If you trust the file, click “More info”, then “Run anyway”.

roadmap.title: What comes next
roadmap.intro: These are plans, not promises: the order and the contents of the versions may change.

items.title: 2.0 — Trade Fleet
items.text: Shared prices and stock readings for a group of up to 10 players on one server. Optional and off by default.

feedback.label: Feedback
feedback.title: Write to the author
feedback.intro: Found a bug or have an idea? Write. You can attach screenshots and the app's log file.
feedback.contact_hint: Optional. For example, your Discord or Twitch name.
feedback.shots_hint: Up to 3 PNG, JPEG or WebP files, 5 MB each at most.
feedback.log_hint: One .log or .txt file, 2 MB at most.
feedback.log_where: Where the log is: in the app, the gear → «Данные» → «Открыть папку логов»; the file is sctrade.log. It holds folder paths with your Windows user name.
feedback.privacy: What you typed and attached is sent: the text, the contact, the screenshots and the log file. Only the author sees it.
feedback.elsewhere: You can write to the author on Twitch:
feedback.success: Thank you! The message has been sent.

errors.too_short: The message is too short: at least 10 characters are needed.
errors.too_long: Too long: the message takes up to 4000 characters, the contact up to 200.
errors.too_many_files: Too many files: up to three screenshots and one log file.
errors.file_too_big: The file is too big: a screenshot takes up to 5 MB, the log up to 2 MB.
errors.bad_file_type: This file will not do: screenshots are PNG, JPEG or WebP, the log is .log or .txt.
errors.rate_limited: Too many messages in a row. Try again later.
errors.spam: The message was not accepted: it looks automated. If that is a mistake, write on Twitch.
errors.server: Sending failed: the server did not answer or answered with an error. Your text is still in the form — try again later.

consent.title: Analytics
consent.text: May the site turn on Google Analytics? It shows the author how many people visit. Analytics is not loaded until you allow it.

data.label: About data
data.title: What the site collects, and what it does not
data.lead: In short: the app sends nothing to this site, and the site keeps only what you send through the form yourself, and a count of presses of Download that says nothing of who pressed. The address a request comes from stays on the server for a short time: see “What the server sees” below.
analytics_off: The site has no analytics. Its pages load no third-party counters or scripts, and set no cookies. Its own count of presses of Download is under “What the server sees”.
analytics_on: The site uses Google Analytics 4 — only after you click “Allow” in the banner. Until then the analytics script is not loaded and its cookies are not set.

After you agree, Google receives data about the visit: which pages you opened and where you came from, the kind of browser and device, an approximate region from the IP address. To tell visits apart, the analytics sets its own cookies.
Your choice is kept in your browser. You can change it with the “Change your choice about analytics” link at the bottom of any page. Declining switches nothing off on the site.
form: Through the form you send what you typed and attached: the text of the message, the contact if you gave one, the pictures and the log file.
The language of the page, the time the form was shown and a hidden field that a person leaves empty go with them: the time and that field are used to filter out robots.

The app's log file holds folder paths with your Windows user name, the Windows version, the screen size, terminal identifiers and prices, the names of the keys you assigned, and the number of the window that had the keyboard before the app's window took it. It holds no titles of other windows and no names or numbers of other processes.
Only the author sees the messages and the files attached to them. They are kept for up to 180 days, or deleted earlier at your request.
server: As on any site, your IP address and the headers your browser sends reach the server with every request.
They are not stored with a message.

The address stays for a short time in two places: in the server's error log, for up to 30 days, and in the rate limiter, for up to a day. The limiter keeps one address from writing too often and from guessing the password of the author's service page, and from running the count of downloads up.

When you press Download, the page tells the server the version of the program and the language of the page, and the server adds one to the count of that day. Who pressed is not kept: no address, no cookie, nothing of the browser.
app: The SC Trade app sends nothing to this site.
It goes online only for UEX data (api.uexcorp.uk). Everything is worked out on your computer.
The settings, your prices and your trips stay on your disk: %APPDATA%\com.sctrade.app. The logs are in %LOCALAPPDATA%\com.sctrade.app\logs.
